properties.name: Pole-mounted transformer (National Grid, formerly Western Power)
properties.notes: Distribution network operator's pole in the hedge beyond the garden wall, with a pole-mounted transformer, high-voltage overhead line on insulators, and a stay wire anchored in the garden lawn. Owner: National Grid Electricity Distribution (formerly Western Power Distribution) (Nat, 2026-11-06). Supply route from here to the house not recorded.
